license_status: No repository LICENSE found at pinned commit; no upstream source module is redistributed. Existing local SKUnit parameters are reused with an independently implemented original-attention forward and dataset-specific head.

data.input: processed CSI (3,90,5), SkeletonPoints (2,18), official TRAIN/TEST ordered lists
data.train_filter: retain current identity iff next_frame zfill(3) is in same TRAIN list
data.test_filter: full official TEST list; no next-frame filtering
data.normalization: per-frame global amplitude min-max before trigger; no post-trigger normalization
data.coordinate_scaling: SkeletonPoints.transpose(1,0)*0.001; inverse reporting factor1000; original image annotation coordinate units, NOT metres
data.preparation: Pinned author's active branch does NOT call dwt_amp despite Amplitude_DWT directory name; dtpose schema only transpose/reshape. Public csi_serial complex input requires declared abs amplitude adaptation and jointsVector x/y extraction.
data.lists: preserve supplied ordered lists; explicitly generated sorted raw-file lists are labelled order adaptation
data.safe_resume: explicit --resume only; immutable preparation.inprogress.json binds raw/source hashes, roots, schema and ordered lists before first processed output; every existing NPZ exactly compared with source conversion; no overwrite; interrupted .saving files preserved and require inspection
data.preflight_gt_scale: positive clean GT reference distance joints5,8 required for all listed frames; no dropping, replacement or TEST-driven threshold choice

model.kind: HPE-Li scratch baseline branch, not full DT-Pose two-stage method
model.attention: original DT-Pose view/reshape convention independently implemented in new WiPoseSKUnit; historical corrected SKUnit unchanged
model.head: Conv128to64to32to16 + Linear32to36; global average feature128
model.inactive_author_parameters: unused conv3/shortcut layers in author SKUnit omitted; active tensors/forward/backward checked with shared state
model.initialization: Xavier normal Conv2d; unit BN1d/2d scales and zero BN biases; Linear default; no pretrained weights

claim: New CSI/HPE2D pilot adaptation. No claim of full original DT-Pose reproduction, WiPose efficacy, GPU performance, or completed paper table.
